table.name: capacity
table.remarks: The three capacity figures for a single location: how many people it is designed for, how many it is certified for, and how many it can safely hold today.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: max_capacity
column.remarks: The most people the location can hold, including overcrowding. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: working_capacity
column.remarks: How many people the location can hold today, allowing for anything currently out of use. Zero for a location that cannot currently be used. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation (CNA): the uncrowded capacity of the location, as certified. Published by MoJ in the prison population statistics. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: cell_certificate
table.remarks: A point-in-time certificate recording what a prison was certified to hold, with the full location tree as it stood when the certificate was issued. A new certificate is issued each time an approval changes certified capacity; only one is current per prison.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: The prison this certificate covers, as a NOMIS agency code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: approved_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who approved the certificate. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: approved_date
column.remarks: When the certificate was approved. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certification_approval_request_id
column.remarks: The approval request that produced this certificate. Null for certificates created by the initial prison baseline rather than by a request. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: total_working_capacity
column.remarks: Total working capacity across the prison at the point of certification. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: total_max_capacity
column.remarks: Total maximum capacity across the prison at the point of certification. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: total_certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Total certified normal accommodation across the prison at the point of certification. Published by MoJ in the prison population statistics. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current
column.remarks: Whether this is the prison's current certificate. Exactly one row per prison should be true; the rest are superseded and kept for history. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: signed_operation_capacity
column.remarks: The prison's signed operational capacity at the point of certification. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: cell_certificate_location
table.remarks: The location tree as recorded on a cell certificate: a frozen copy taken when the certificate was issued, so the certificate remains an accurate record even after the live locations change.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_certificate_id
column.remarks: The certificate this location belongs to. Deleted with the certificate. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_code
column.remarks: The location's own code within its parent, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: path_hierarchy
column.remarks: Full path of the location within the prison, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation for this location, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: working_capacity
column.remarks: Working capacity for this location, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: max_capacity
column.remarks: Maximum capacity for this location, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: Whether the cell had its own toilet and washing facilities, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_type
column.remarks: What kind of location this is. See LocationType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: specialist_cell_types
column.remarks: Specialist cell types held against the location, comma separated, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_mark
column.remarks: The number on the cell door, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: level
column.remarks: Depth of this location in the certificate's tree, with the top level location at the lowest number. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: local_name
column.remarks: The name the prison used for this location, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: parent_location_id
column.remarks: The location above this one within the certificate's own tree, not the live location tree. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: converted_cell_type
column.remarks: What a former cell was being used as, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: used_for_types
column.remarks: What the cell was used for, comma separated, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: accommodation_types
column.remarks: Accommodation types for the location, comma separated, as certified. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: other_converted_cell_type
column.remarks: Free text description used when the certified converted_cell_type was OTHER. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: cell_certificate_upload
table.remarks: One run of the bulk import that seeds or corrects a prison's cell certificate from a spreadsheet, with counts of how the run went.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: The prison being imported, as a NOMIS agency code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: status
column.remarks: Where the run has got to - PENDING, STARTED or FINISHED. See CellCertificateUploadStatus in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: requested_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who started the import. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: requested_date
column.remarks: When the import was requested. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: start_time
column.remarks: When processing actually began. Null while the run is still queued. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: end_time
column.remarks: When processing finished. Null while the run is still going. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: total_records
column.remarks: How many rows the uploaded file contained. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: processed_records
column.remarks: How many rows were applied successfully. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: skipped_records
column.remarks: How many rows were deliberately skipped, typically because they matched what the service already held. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: failed_records
column.remarks: How many rows could not be applied. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: reason_for_change
column.remarks: Free text from the requester explaining why the import was run. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_certificate_id
column.remarks: The certificate produced by this run, once it has completed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: discrepancy_records
column.remarks: How many rows differed from what the service already held, and so needed review rather than straight application. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certification_approval_request_id
column.remarks: The approval request raised off the back of this import, where the discrepancies needed approving. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: cell_certificate_upload_location
table.remarks: One row of a bulk certificate import: the values being imported for a location, the values the service already held, and what happened when the two were reconciled.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_certificate_upload_id
column.remarks: The import run this row belongs to. Deleted with the run. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_key
column.remarks: The location this row is about, as {prisonId}-{pathHierarchy}. Matched by key rather than by id because the spreadsheet has no ids. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: max_capacity
column.remarks: Maximum capacity given in the uploaded file. A proposed value until the import is approved. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: working_capacity
column.remarks: Working capacity given in the uploaded file. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation given in the uploaded file. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: cell_mark
column.remarks: Cell door number given in the uploaded file. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: In-cell sanitation setting given in the uploaded file. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: status
column.remarks: What happened to this row - PENDING, PROCESSED, SKIPPED or FAILED. See CellCertificateUploadLocationStatus in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: previous_max_capacity
column.remarks: Maximum capacity the service held for this location before the import, for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: previous_working_capacity
column.remarks: Working capacity the service held before the import, for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: previous_certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation the service held before the import, for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: previous_cell_mark
column.remarks: Cell door number the service held before the import, for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: previous_in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: In-cell sanitation setting the service held before the import, for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: message
column.remarks: System generated explanation of why the row was skipped or failed. Not typed by a user. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: processed_date
column.remarks: When this row was processed. Null while the row is still pending. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: working_capacity_mismatch
column.remarks: Whether the uploaded working capacity differed from what the service already held, flagging the row for review. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: max_capacity_mismatch
column.remarks: Whether the uploaded maximum capacity differed from what the service already held. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation_mismatch
column.remarks: Whether the uploaded certified normal accommodation differed from what the service already held. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: applied_max_capacity
column.remarks: The maximum capacity actually applied to the location, which can differ from the uploaded value where the import had to reconcile a mismatch. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

table.name: cell_used_for
table.remarks: What a cell is used for. A cell can serve several purposes, so this is a list rather than a column on location.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The cell this applies to. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: used_for
column.remarks: What the cell is used for - STANDARD_ACCOMMODATION, FIRST_NIGHT_CENTRE, DRUG_RECOVERY_UNIT and so on. See UsedForType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: certification_approval_request
table.remarks: A request to change something that affects a prison's certified capacity, awaiting review. Holds both the proposed values and a snapshot of the current ones, so the request can be assessed without re-reading the live locations.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: Prison the request applies to, as a NOMIS agency code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The location the request is about. Null for prison-wide requests such as a signed operational capacity change. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_key
column.remarks: The location's key ({prisonId}-{pathHierarchy}) captured when the request was raised, so the request stays readable if the location is later renamed or removed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: status
column.remarks: Where the request has got to - PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED or WITHDRAWN. See ApprovalRequestStatus in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: requested_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who raised the request. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: requested_date
column.remarks: When the request was raised. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: approved_or_rejected_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who approved or rejected the request. Null while it is still pending. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: approved_or_rejected_date
column.remarks: When the request was approved or rejected. Null while it is still pending. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: comments
column.remarks: Free text left by the approver explaining their decision. Assume it can name a prisoner. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation_change
column.remarks: Net change to the prison's certified normal accommodation if this request is approved. A proposal, not the published figure. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: working_capacity_change
column.remarks: Net change to working capacity if this request is approved. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: max_capacity_change
column.remarks: Net change to maximum capacity if this request is approved. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: approval_type
column.remarks: What kind of change is being requested - DEACTIVATION, CAPACITY_CHANGE, SIGNED_OP_CAP and so on. Determines which of the proposed value columns below are populated. See ApprovalType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: signed_operation_capacity_change
column.remarks: Net change to the prison's signed operational capacity if this request is approved. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: signed_operation_capacity_id
column.remarks: The signed_operation_capacity row this request would update. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: reason_for_change
column.remarks: Free text from the requester explaining why the change is needed. Assume it can name a prisoner. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: current_signed_operation_capacity
column.remarks: The prison's signed operational capacity when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. Already published, so not sensitive in itself. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_mark
column.remarks: Proposed new cell door number. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: deactivated_reason
column.remarks: Proposed reason for taking the location out of use. See DeactivatedReason in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: deactivation_reason_description
column.remarks: Free text expanding on the proposed deactivation reason. Assume it can name a prisoner. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: proposed_reactivation_date
column.remarks: Date the location is expected to come back into use, if the deactivation is approved. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: planet_fm_reference
column.remarks: Planet FM job reference for the maintenance work behind the request. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: Proposed in-cell sanitation setting. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_cell_mark
column.remarks: The cell door number when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: The in-cell sanitation setting when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: max_capacity
column.remarks: Proposed maximum capacity for the location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: working_capacity
column.remarks: Proposed working capacity for the location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Proposed certified normal accommodation for the location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: pending_specialist_cell_types
column.remarks: Proposed specialist cell types, as a comma separated list. Denormalised because the request is a snapshot rather than a live relationship. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: converted_cell_type
column.remarks: Proposed non-residential use for a cell being converted. See ConvertedCellType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: other_converted_cell_type
column.remarks: Free text description used when the proposed converted_cell_type is OTHER. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: accommodation_type
column.remarks: Proposed accommodation type for the location. See AccommodationType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: used_for_types
column.remarks: Proposed list of what the cell is used for, comma separated. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_accommodation_types
column.remarks: The accommodation types when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_used_for_types
column.remarks: What the cell was used for when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: top_level_accommodation_types
column.remarks: Accommodation types of the top level location above this one, so a reviewer can see the request in the context of the wing it sits in. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: top_level_used_for_types
column.remarks: What the top level location above this one is used for, for the same reason. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: certification_approval_request_location
table.remarks: The locations covered by an approval request, held as a self-contained tree that is copied from the live locations when the request is raised. Kept separate from the location table so a request shows what was asked for even if the estate changes afterwards.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certification_approval_request_id
column.remarks: The approval request this location belongs to. Deleted with the request. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_code
column.remarks: The location's own code within its parent, copied from the live location. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_mark
column.remarks: Proposed number on the cell door. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: local_name
column.remarks: The name the prison uses for this location. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: path_hierarchy
column.remarks: Full path of the location within the prison, copied when the request was raised. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: level
column.remarks: Depth of this location in the request's tree, with the top level location at the lowest number. Lets the tree be rendered without recursion. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Proposed certified normal accommodation for this location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: working_capacity
column.remarks: Proposed working capacity for this location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: max_capacity
column.remarks: Proposed maximum capacity for this location. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: Proposed in-cell sanitation setting for this location. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_type
column.remarks: What kind of location this is. See LocationType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: specialist_cell_types
column.remarks: Proposed specialist cell types, comma separated. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: converted_cell_type
column.remarks: Proposed non-residential use for a cell being converted. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: parent_location_id
column.remarks: The location above this one within the request's own tree, not the live location tree. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: used_for_types
column.remarks: Proposed list of what the cell is used for, comma separated. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: accommodation_types
column.remarks: Proposed accommodation types, comma separated. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_working_capacity
column.remarks: Working capacity when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: current_max_capacity
column.remarks: Maximum capacity when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: current_certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE]

column.name: reactivate_this_location
column.remarks: Whether this particular location should be brought back into use if the request is approved. A request can cover a tree in which only some locations are reactivated. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_specialist_cell_types
column.remarks: Specialist cell types when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_cell_mark
column.remarks: The cell door number when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: current_in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: In-cell sanitation setting when the request was raised, as a snapshot for comparison. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: certification_backup
table.remarks: One-off backup taken by migration V1_74 (CREATE TABLE AS SELECT) before certification data moved onto the location table. Not written to by the application and not read by anything - a candidate for removal in a later migration.

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The location the backed up certification row belonged to. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certificate_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the row in the old certification table, which has since been dropped. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified
column.remarks: Whether the location was certified, as at migration V1_74. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified_normal_accommodation
column.remarks: Certified normal accommodation for the location, as at migration V1_74. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: constant_transaction_type
table.remarks: A copy of the TransactionType enumeration as a table, so reporting tools and the Analytical Platform can decode linked_transaction.transaction_type without hard-coding the list. Kept in sync with the enum by ConstantsTableTest. Deliberately not the target of a foreign key.

column.name: code
column.remarks: Primary key: the transaction type code as stored in linked_transaction.transaction_type. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: sequence
column.remarks: Display order, matching the order the values are declared in the Kotlin enum. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: description
column.remarks: Human readable description of the transaction type. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: linked_transaction
table.remarks: One user action or system job, grouping together every location change it caused. Lets the history be read as "what somebody did" rather than as isolated field changes.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key, and the transaction identifier exposed in the API. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: transaction_type
column.remarks: What kind of action this was, such as LOCATION_UPDATE or CAPACITY_CHANGE. Decoded by the constant_transaction_type table. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: transaction_detail
column.remarks: System generated one line summary of the action, built from a template rather than typed by a user. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: transaction_invoked_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who performed the action, or a system identifier for automated jobs. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: tx_start_time
column.remarks: When the transaction started. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: tx_end_time
column.remarks: When the transaction finished. Null if it is still running or did not complete. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: Prison the transaction applied to, as a NOMIS agency code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: location
table.remarks: Every location inside a prison, from a wing down to an individual cell, held as a self-referencing tree via parent_id. Single-table inheritance: location_type_discriminator says which kind of location a row is, and which columns are meaningful.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. A UUIDv7 generated by the application, used as the location's permanent public identifier across DPS. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: Prison the location belongs to, as a NOMIS agency code such as MDI. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: path_hierarchy
column.remarks: Full path of the location within the prison, hyphen separated, such as A-1-001. Unique within a prison and used with prison_id to form the location key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: code
column.remarks: The location's own code within its parent, such as 001 for cell A-1-001. Not unique on its own. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_type
column.remarks: What kind of location this is - WING, LANDING, CELL, ADJUDICATION_ROOM and so on. See LocationType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: parent_id
column.remarks: The location immediately above this one in the tree. Null for a top level location such as a wing. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: local_name
column.remarks: Name the prison uses for this location in conversation, such as "Houseblock 1". Optional; the path hierarchy is the authoritative identifier. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: comments
column.remarks: Free text notes about the location. Free text: assume it can name a prisoner, for example when explaining why a cell is out of use. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: order_within_parent_location
column.remarks: Sort order among siblings, so a wing's landings list in the order staff expect rather than alphabetically. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: residential_housing_type
column.remarks: Legacy NOMIS housing classification, superseded by accommodation_type. Retained because historic rows and the NOMIS sync still carry it. See ResidentialHousingType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: capacity_id
column.remarks: Foreign key to capacity, holding this location's working capacity, maximum capacity and certified normal accommodation. Null for locations that hold no one. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: deactivated_date
column.remarks: When the location was taken out of use. Null while it is in use. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: deactivated_reason
column.remarks: Why the location was taken out of use - DAMAGED, MAINTENANCE, REFURBISHMENT and so on. See DeactivatedReason in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: proposed_reactivation_date
column.remarks: Date the prison expects the location to come back into use. An estimate, not a commitment. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: when_created
column.remarks: When this location record was first created. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: when_updated
column.remarks: When this location record was last changed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the last person to change this location. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: accommodation_type
column.remarks: What the location is used for at the top level - NORMAL_ACCOMMODATION, HEALTHCARE_INPATIENTS, CARE_AND_SEPARATION or OTHER_NON_RESIDENTIAL. Drives roll count reporting. See AccommodationType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: planet_fm_reference
column.remarks: Reference for the corresponding job in Planet FM, the facilities management system, when a location is out of use for maintenance. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: converted_cell_type
column.remarks: What a former cell is now used as, when it has been converted to a non-residential room - OFFICE, STORE, SHOWER and so on. See ConvertedCellType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: other_converted_cell_type
column.remarks: Free text description used when converted_cell_type is OTHER. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: archived_reason
column.remarks: Why the location was permanently archived rather than merely deactivated. Free text: assume it can name a prisoner. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: deactivated_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who took the location out of use. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: deactivation_reason_description
column.remarks: Free text expanding on deactivated_reason, and the only detail available when the reason is OTHER. Assume it can name a prisoner - "damaged by" is a common phrasing. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: location_type_discriminator
column.remarks: Single-table inheritance discriminator: CELL, RESIDENTIAL, NON_RESIDENTIAL or VIRTUAL. Determines which subclass the row maps to and therefore which columns apply. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: status
column.remarks: Lifecycle state of the location - DRAFT, ACTIVE, INACTIVE or ARCHIVED. See LocationStatus in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: in_cell_sanitation
column.remarks: Whether the cell has its own toilet and washing facilities. Part of the certified specification of a cell. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: cell_mark
column.remarks: The number physically painted on the cell door, which can differ from the location code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: residential_structure
column.remarks: Hyphen separated list of the location types making up the path from the top of the prison down to this location, such as WING-LANDING-CELL. Denormalised so the shape of a prison can be read without walking the tree. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: internal_movement_allowed
column.remarks: Whether prisoners may move to and from this non-residential location unescorted. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certified_cell
column.remarks: Whether the cell currently appears on the prison's cell certificate. A cell that is not certified must not be used to hold anyone. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: temporarily_off_cell_cert
column.remarks: Whether a certified cell is temporarily suspended from the certificate, for example during refurbishment, without losing its certification. Required for rows where the discriminator is CELL. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: hidden_from_list
column.remarks: Whether the location is suppressed from the location lists shown in the UI. Used for locations that exist for data reasons but that staff should not browse. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: location_history
table.remarks: Audit trail of every change to a location: one row per changed attribute, tied to the transaction that changed it.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The location that changed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: attribute_name
column.remarks: Which attribute of the location changed, such as CAPACITY or CODE. See LocationAttribute in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: old_value
column.remarks: The attribute's value before the change, rendered as text. Carries the sensitivity of whichever attribute changed, so where the attribute was a free-text field this can name a prisoner. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: new_value
column.remarks: The attribute's value after the change, rendered as text. Same caveat as old_value. [Sensitivity: PERSONAL]

column.name: amended_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who made the change. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: amended_date
column.remarks: When the change was made. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: linked_transaction_id
column.remarks: The transaction this change belonged to, so all the changes made by one user action can be read together. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: non_residential_usage
table.remarks: What a non-residential location is used for, such as visits or adjudications. A location can have several usages.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The non-residential location this usage applies to. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: usage_type
column.remarks: What the location is used for - ADJUDICATION_HEARING, VISIT, PROGRAMMES_ACTIVITIES and so on. Legacy NOMIS classification; service_usage is the modern equivalent. See NonResidentialUsageType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: capacity
column.remarks: How many people the location holds for this particular usage, which can differ from its residential capacity. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: sequence
column.remarks: Sort order when a location has more than one usage. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: prison_configuration
table.remarks: Per-prison settings controlling how this service behaves at that prison. One row per prison, keyed by the prison code itself.

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: Primary key: the prison, as a NOMIS agency code. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: when_updated
column.remarks: When the configuration was last changed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who last changed the configuration. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: resi_location_service_active
column.remarks: Whether the prison manages its residential locations in this service rather than in NOMIS. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: include_segregation_in_roll_count
column.remarks: Whether prisoners in segregation are counted in the prison's roll count figures. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: certification_approval_required
column.remarks: Whether changes affecting certified capacity at this prison must go through the approval workflow before taking effect. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: non_resi_service_active
column.remarks: Whether the prison manages its non-residential locations in this service rather than in NOMIS. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: prison_notification_mailbox
table.remarks: Email addresses notified about cell certification activity. A row with a null prison_id is the national default for that notification group.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: The prison this mailbox serves, as a NOMIS agency code. Null means it is the default used for any prison without its own entry. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: notification_group
column.remarks: Which role the mailbox is notified in - CERT_ADMIN, CERT_VIEWER or CERT_REVIEWER. See NotificationGroup in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: email_address
column.remarks: Address notified. Usually a shared team mailbox, but can be an individual member of staff, so treat it as staff personal data. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

column.name: when_updated
column.remarks: When the mailbox entry was last changed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who last changed the mailbox entry. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

table.name: residential_attribute
table.remarks: Legacy NOMIS attributes of a residential location, retained for the NOMIS sync and for historic reporting. Superseded by specialist_cell and cell_used_for.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The location the attribute applies to. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: attribute_type
column.remarks: Which NOMIS attribute domain the value belongs to, such as LOCATION_ATTRIBUTE or SANITATION_FITTINGS. See ResidentialAttributeType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: attribute_value
column.remarks: The NOMIS attribute value itself. See ResidentialAttributeValue in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: service_usage
table.remarks: Which DPS services a non-residential location is available to, so each service can offer only the locations relevant to it.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The location this applies to. Deleted with the location. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: service_type
column.remarks: The service the location is available to, such as ADJUDICATION_HEARING or VIDEO_LINK. See ServiceType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]

table.name: signed_operation_capacity
table.remarks: The signed operational capacity of a prison: the maximum population the governor has signed off as safe to hold. One current row per prison.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: prison_id
column.remarks: The prison, as a NOMIS agency code. Unique. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: signed_operation_capacity
column.remarks: The signed operational capacity figure itself. Published by MoJ in the prison population statistics. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: when_updated
column.remarks: When the figure was last changed. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: updated_by
column.remarks: DPS username of the person who last changed the figure. [Sensitivity: STAFF]

table.name: specialist_cell
table.remarks: Specialist cell types held against a cell, such as accessible or constant supervision cells. A cell can have several.

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: location_id
column.remarks: The cell this applies to. [Sensitivity: NONE]

column.name: specialist_cell_type
column.remarks: The specialist type - ACCESSIBLE_CELL, CONSTANT_SUPERVISION, SAFE_CELL and so on. Some types reduce the cell's usable capacity. See SpecialistCellType in reference-data.csv. [Sensitivity: NONE]
